method: Each election-specific contestant is linked to a row of the Federal Returning Officer's longitudinal results table only when the table's national second-vote count for that election equals the contestant's official count exactly and uniquely. Labels and names are never compared. The table's own notes on earlier party names are recorded verbatim.
evidence_basis: official_code (identity model): the authority's stable longitudinal row in its own published table. This is the electoral authority's statistical attribution of results to one party across elections, not a party-register or legal-entity determination.

relationship_categories.same_organisation_per_authority_series: A — the authority presents these elections as one party's results and records no name change
relationship_categories.name_change_documented_by_authority: B — one party series whose ballot label changed; the authority's notes record the earlier names
relationship_categories.electoral_alliance_or_joint_list: C — none: every canonical contestant 2002–2025 is recorded as a party_list; alliances would never be merged with member parties
relationship_categories.merger_split_or_succession: D — none documented in this source; not inferred
relationship_categories.unresolved: E — contestants not linked by an exact official count; they stay election-specific
